question_en: What are the narrative locations of the movie 2001 A space odyssey?
question_fr: Quels sont les lieux narratifs du film 2001, l'Odyssée de l'espace ?
translation_note: Each evaluation carries an English (`question_en`) and a French (`question_fr`) form. One side is the original input typed by the user; the other is automatically translated by gpt-4o (gpt-6-sol since 2026-10-01) through Phase 5 (EN→FR) or Phase 6 (FR→EN) of the evaluator. Translations are generally high-quality but may differ in wording from a natively-typed equivalent — keep this in mind when comparing API outputs across languages.
assertion_refresh_sql: SELECT DISTINCT T_WC_T2S_LOCATION.ID_LOCATION, T_WC_T2S_LOCATION.LOCATION_NAME, T_WC_T2S_LOCATION.LOCATION_TYPE, T_WC_T2S_LOCATION.LOCATION_SOURCE, T_WC_T2S_LOCATION.POSTER_PATH, T_WC_T2S_LOCATION.WIKIPEDIA_IMAGE_PATH, T_WC_T2S_LOCATION.OVERVIEW, T_WC_T2S_LOCATION.MOVIE_COUNT, T_WC_T2S_LOCATION.SERIE_COUNT, T_WC_T2S_LOCATION.IMDB_RATING FROM T_WC_T2S_LOCATION JOIN T_WC_T2S_MOVIE_LOCATION ON T_WC_T2S_MOVIE_LOCATION.ID_LOCATION = T_WC_T2S_LOCATION.ID_LOCATION JOIN T_WC_T2S_MOVIE ON T_WC_T2S_MOVIE.ID_MOVIE = T_WC_T2S_MOVIE_LOCATION.ID_MOVIE WHERE (T_WC_T2S_MOVIE.MOVIE_TITLE = '2001: A Space Odyssey' OR T_WC_T2S_MOVIE.MOVIE_TITLE_FR = '2001: A Space Odyssey' OR T_WC_T2S_MOVIE.ORIGINAL_TITLE = '2001: A Space Odyssey') AND T_WC_T2S_MOVIE_LOCATION.LOCATION_ROLE = 'narrative' AND T_WC_T2S_LOCATION.DELETED = 0 ORDER BY T_WC_T2S_LOCATION.MOVIE_COUNT DESC LIMIT 15
